actual.t: ALIGNED TEST VERSION: This teaching draft demonstrates constructive alignment for Differential Calculus. Students analyze engineering functions, limits and continuity; calculate and verify derivatives; and construct related-rates and optimization models. They explain their mathematical reasoning and communicate engineering recommendations with honest limitations and consideration for workers and communities. Weekly practice and assessment use the same mathematical objectives. Program Outcomes labeled TEST ONLY are provisional examples, not official institutional references. This draft must not be submitted as an officially verified syllabus.
